documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Considering, Approving & Taking On Record The Unaudited Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended On September 30, 2026 And To Conduct Any Other Businesses As May Be Decided By The Board.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM

analysis.summary: D.P. Abhushan Limited reported a 58% year-on-year growth in total revenue to INR 853.63 crores for Q1 FY27, with profit after tax rising 77% to INR 64 crores. The company achieved a same-store sales growth of 52% and noted that old gold exchange contributed approximately 25% of total sales during the quarter. Management announced expansion into Dahod, Gujarat, and Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, marking its first franchisee-owned company-operated (FOCO) showroom. Looking ahead, the company targets 10% annual volume growth for FY27 and FY28 and plans to expand its network towards a long-term vision of 51 stores.

guidance.claim: The company targets approximately 10% volume growth for both FY27 and FY28.
guidance.quote: Yes, that's correct. Internally, we are planning for approximately 10% volume growth, and that remains our broad target for both FY27 and FY28.

guidance.claim: The company aims to increase its overall studded jewellery mix to 12% to 15% by March '28.
guidance.quote: And we have targeted by March ‘28, we would like to increase up to 12% to 15% on an overall basis.

guidance.claim: The company maintains a long-term vision to achieve a total of 51 stores.
guidance.quote: So, by this way we will achieve this 51 which is our vision also.

guidance.claim: The company aims to grow at an annual rate of approximately 25% to 30% over the next five years by the end of 2030.
guidance.quote: Over the next five years, by the end of 2030, we aim to grow at an annual rate of approximately 25% to 30%.

guidance.claim: Management targets EBITDA margins to remain between 8% and 8.5% as part of its FY30 vision.
guidance.quote: So, we are targeting EBITDA margins to remain between 8% and 8.5%, which is our FY30 vision already in place.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue of INR 4,800 crores for FY27 and INR 5,500 crores for the next year.
guidance.quote: So FY27 and FY28, the revenue we are planning around like 20%, 25% growth. So INR4,800 crores, and the next year will be INR5,500 crores.

guidance.claim: Management guides the EBITDA margin to be around 6% to 6.5% in FY27.
guidance.quote: Our margin guidance will be around 6% to 6.5%, EBITDA margin.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting top-line revenue contribution of around 3% to 5% from its online and digital venture over the next three to five years.
guidance.quote: So, over the long term, in the next three to five years, we are targeting around 3% to 5% of our topline revenue to come from this segment.

demand_outlook.claim: D.P. Abhushan recorded a footfall-to-conversion ratio of 81% in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: In Q1 FY27, footfall at our stores was encouraging, and the footfall-to-conversion ratio stood at 81%, showing strong buying intent and effective in-store engagement.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's average ticket size was approximately Rs. 1,57,000 in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: During the quarter, our average ticket size was approximately Rs. 1,57,000, supported by wedding-led purchases and festive demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Overall same-store sales growth for the company stood at 52% in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Our same-store sales growth stood at 52% on an overall basis.

demand_outlook.claim: Wedding-related purchases were the largest contributor to Q1 sales at 62%.
demand_outlook.quote: In terms of product category mix, wedding related purchases remained the largest contributor, accounting for 62% of the sales during the quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Wedding jewellery continues to dominate the product mix at approximately 60%.
demand_outlook.quote: From a product mix perspective, wedding jewellery continues to dominate at ~60%, followed by festival and lightweight jewellery at ~25%, and corporate and other gifting at ~15%, reflecting a well-diversified and demand-aligned portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: Volume growth saw a decline of around 20% overall in FY26 as growth was driven primarily by value.
demand_outlook.quote: In FY26, most of our growth was driven by value rather than volume. On the volume side, we actually saw a decline of around 20% overall.

demand_outlook.claim: Old gold exchange contribution stands at approximately 35% to 40% as of now.
demand_outlook.quote: So, the old gold exchange is somewhere 35% to 40% as of now.

demand_outlook.claim: Silver demand remains intact, and management is seeing a shift toward silver due to increasing gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: Silver demand remains intact. In fact, with gold prices increasing and impacting demand, we are seeing a shift towards silver.

capex_expansion.claim: The company finalized new showroom locations in Dahod, Gujarat, and Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh.
capex_expansion.quote: Under this roadmap, we have successfully finalized the locations for new showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, and Dahod, Gujarat.

capex_expansion.claim: The Dahod showroom will span approximately 3,200 sq. ft. under a company-owned company-operated model.
capex_expansion.quote: The Dahod showroom will be approximately 3,200 sq. ft. and will mark our strategic entry into the Gujarat market. This showroom will operate under the Company-Owned Company-Operated model.

capex_expansion.claim: The Jabalpur showroom will measure around 3,750 sq. ft. under the franchisee-owned company-operated model.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second showroom, in Jabalpur, will be approximately 3,750 sq. ft. and will be our first Franchisee-Owned Company-Operated model showroom.

capex_expansion.claim: The company targets adding approximately five to six new stores during the current year.
capex_expansion.quote: For this year as well, we are targeting the addition of approximately five to six new stores.

capex_expansion.claim: The total showroom network reached 12 with the inauguration of a new showroom in Dhar and expansion in Ratlam.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, the Company further strengthened its footprint in Central India with the successful inauguration of a new s in Dhar, following the expansion in Ratlam earlier in the year, taking the total showroom network to 12.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to open three to four new stores and one franchise store for the current year.
capex_expansion.quote: For this year, we have planned to open three to four new stores. Additionally, we have already finalized one franchisee and will be opening one franchise store as well.

capex_expansion.claim: The long-term goal is to reach around 51 stores by 2030.
capex_expansion.quote: Our long-term goal is to reach around 51 stores by 2030.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 PAT margin expanded by 82 basis points year-on-year to 7.55%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin expanded to 7.55%, up 82 basis points year-on-year, reflecting strong profitability growth and sustained efficiency across the businesses.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA grew 70% year-on-year to INR 93.99 crores in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: At operating level, EBITDA increased by 70% year-on-year to INR93.99 crores in Q1 '27 as compared to INR55 crores in Q1 '26.

margins_costs.claim: Full year FY26 EBITDA margins improved to 7.61%, an expansion of 234 basis points over FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR309.7 crores, reflecting a strong growth of 77% YoY, with EBITDA margins improving to 7.61%, an expansion of 234 basis points over FY25.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margins for full year FY26 improved to 5.20%, an expansion of 180 basis points over FY25.
margins_costs.quote: PAT stood at INR211.8 crores, delivering a robust growth of 88% YoY, with PAT margins improving to 5.20%, an expansion of 180 basis points over FY25.

margins_costs.claim: Approximately 28% to 30% of inventory gains were reflected in the books during FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Approximately 28% to 30% of the inventory gains have been reflected in our books.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates with an annual inventory turnover ratio between 4.7x and 5.0x.
orders_capacity.quote: Our business currently operates with an inventory turnover ratio of around 4.7x to 5.0x annually, which, in our view, is among the best in the industry.

orders_capacity.claim: Total retail store area stood at approximately 53,650 square feet during FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Our total retail store area stood at ~53,650 sq. ft. supporting our growing scale of operations.

orders_capacity.claim: Average revenue delivered was approximately INR 7.6 lakhs per sq. ft. and INR 339 crores per store for FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: On the productivity front, we delivered an average revenue of ~INR7.6 lakhs per sq. ft. and ~INR339 crores per store for FY26, reflecting strong store-level performance and efficient utilization of retail space.

orders_capacity.claim: Inventory turnover stood at approximately 4.7x for FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: while inventory turnover stood at ~4.7x, highlighting efficient inventory management and faster stock rotation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company uses gold metal loans, exchange-based procurement, and MCX hedging to manage working capital and price volatility.
capital_allocation.quote: The company continues to leverage exchange led procurement of gold, gold metal loan, and hedging mechanisms on the commodity exchange platform to mitigate gold price volatility, support margin stability, and improve working capital efficiency.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has put its planned QIP on hold due to unfavourable market conditions.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, we are planning to undertake a QIP; however, we have currently put it on hold as market conditions are not favourable. As a result, we have not proceeded with it yet.

capital_allocation.claim: Expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 will be executed through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: As far as our expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 are concerned, they will be executed through internal accruals as well.

risks_headwinds.claim: The gold import duty increase from 6% to 15% in May 2026 created near-term cost and demand sensitivity.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the recent government announcement and increase in gold import duty from 6% to 15% in May 2026 has introduced near-term cost and demand sensitivity, the long-term fundamentals of the sector remain intact, supported by India’s cultural affinity for gold, wedding and festive led demand, rising formalisation, omnichannel adoption.

risks_headwinds.claim: High gold prices during the early part of Q1 FY27 influenced buying decisions among price-sensitive consumers.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the early part of the quarter, high gold prices continued to influence purchase decisions, particularly among price-sensitive consumers.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that gold prices played a very important role in the last quarter due to geopolitical situations.
risks_headwinds.quote: See Chetan, the gold prices was playing a very important role in the last quarter, which everybody has visualized, because of the geopolitical situation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Demand can be temporarily affected by seasonality, such as June and July seeing relatively lower demand after the wedding season concludes.
risks_headwinds.quote: That said, demand can be temporarily affected by seasonality. For instance, the wedding season has recently concluded, and months like June and July typically see relatively lower demand.
